subject: Post-demo next steps: evaluation timeline, ownership, and exec review window
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Sawyer <michael.sawyer@cerebralhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & proposed evaluation plan after today's demo

Hi Michael — thanks again for taking the demo with the team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary
- Demo covered: streaming answers, private-data routing, and cost controls for high-volume note generation.
- Cerebral's main success goal: reduce clinician documentation time by 30% and maintain >95% factuality on patient notes.

Proposed evaluation plan (draft)
- Pilot length: 3 weeks (recommended) — baseline week + 2-week evaluation with adaptive batching on day 4.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in time-on-task (logs + sampling), 95% factuality by human spot-check, latency P95 < 450ms for 512-token requests.
- Owners: Jordan (AM) — overall trial coordination; Neha (Solutions Eng) — integration + security checklist; Dylan (CS) — acceptance criteria and onboarding.

Attachments: redwood-draft-map.xlsx (mutual action plan), redwood-eval-template.md (sample eval runbook). Please review and confirm owners/timeframes.

Immediate asks
1) Michael: confirm pilot length preference (2 / 3 / 4 weeks) and any mandatory procurement gating items.
2) Team: if the above metrics look off, call them out now so we can align the runbook.
3) Proposed exec readout window: Sep 6–10 (slot for go/no-go + contract next steps). Please indicate which dates/times work for your execs.

If you prefer, I can convert the MAP into a short SOW for procurement to review.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-draft-map.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood-eval-template.md (markdown runbook stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Sawyer <michael.sawyer@cerebralhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed evaluation plan after today's demo

Thanks Jordan — nice capture. Couple of tactical items I want to add from the solutions side: 

Technical checklist (must-have before kick):
- API keys and VPC egress allowlist
- Sample dataset (10k notes anonymized) + expected token sizes
- SOC2 export / redaction guidance: confirm whether PHI will be in sample set (if PHI, we need encryption at rest + documented retention).

Evaluation cadence suggestion
- Week 0: integration + smoke tests (owner: Neha)
- Week 1: baseline collection (owner: Cerebral)
- Week 2: tuned config + quality sampling (owner: Dylan)
- Week 3: readout prep + exec review (owner: Jordan)

On pilot length: I can support 3 weeks, but if procurement insists on a formal SOW we'll need to produce a 1–page SOW and hand it over; recommend we produce that in parallel and not block kickoff.

For the exec readout window, seconded: Sep 6 or Sep 7 morning PT would be clean from our side.

I'll attach a short eval-template and an integration checklist to this thread.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-08-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed evaluation plan after today's demo

Jordan / Team — thanks, this is helpful. A few notes from my side after syncing with ops and procurement: 

1) Pilot length: procurement wants to see a 4-week pilot on paper for legal/procurement comfort (we can still run the evaluation checkpoints at week 2 and 3).

2) Procurement ask: 1-page SOW + statement of data handling during pilot (we'll need retention window and deletion confirmation).

3) Exec review: Sep 8 or Sep 9 works better for our Exec Director (she's traveling Sep 6–7). Sep 8 at 10:00 AM PT would be ideal.

4) Attendees for the exec readout: myself, Exec Director (Sarah Lin), Head of Clinical Ops (Marta Reyes), plus procurement as observers.

If you can share the MAP + 1-page SOW by EOD Aug 5, procurement will start their paperwork. Attaching the procurement checklist they sent me.

Thanks,
Michael Sawyer
Director of Product Operations | Cerebral Health
michael.sawyer@cerebralhealth.com

1) We'll formalize the MAP into a 1-page SOW and a short data-handling statement and send both by EOD Aug 5 (Jordan).
2) Neha will publish the integration checklist and the eval runbook with checkpoints on the shared Drive (Neha).
3) Dylan will prepare the acceptance criteria spreadsheet + sampling plan (Dylan).

Proposed exec readout: Sep 8, 10:00 AM PT. Agenda (draft): 10m intro & objectives (Jordan), 15m quality + metric results (Dylan), 10m ops/infra summary (Neha), 15m decision discussion & contract path (Jordan + procurement).

I'll add a HubSpot activity and the Drive folder link so we have a single source of truth: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/8472 and the Drive folder in related links.

If that looks good I will: 1) send the SOW + data statement; 2) set a tentative calendar invite for Sep 8 10:00 AM PT with the draft agenda and pre-read due Sep 2.
